steps.text: Talk to Larry at the Ardougne Zoo.
Talk to Larry again.
choices: Yes, I have all the materials.

steps.text: Use an oak plank on the firm snow patch.
Use a spade on the bird hide to cover it in snow.
Talk to Larry on the iceberg to enter the bird hide.
Talk to Larry again.
Click the boat to return to Relleka.
Talk to Larry in Relleka.
Travel to your POH or another POH with a Crafting table 3 or 4.
Craft a steel bar into a clockwork at a crafting table 3.
Craft a clockwork penguin at a crafting table 3 or 4.
Talk to Larry back in the Ardougne Zoo.
Talk to Larry on the iceberg.
choices: It looks like a warning message to keep us away.

steps.text: Read the mission report.
Unequip cape and weapons and right-click Tuxedo-time Larry at the Ardougne Zoo.
Enter the penguin pen.
Talk to the zoo penguin.
Perform the correct series of emotes to the penguin.
Talk to Larry to exit the penguin suit.
Talk to Larry about the mission report, then travel to the sheep farm in Lumbridge.
Tuxedo-time Larry in the Lumbridge sheep farm.
Talk to the penguins disguised as a sheep in the Lumbridge sheep farm. You will need to use the same 3 emotes as the penguin from the bird hide cutscene.
Perform the correct series of emotes to the penguin.
Return to the Ardougne Zoo penguin with either a raw cod, or wearing the ring of charos.
choices: The penguins in Lumbridge refuse to talk to me.
I must have left the outpost before they gave out the phrase.

steps.text: Speak to the sheep-penguins again in the Lumbridge sheep farm.
Talk to Fred the Farmer without the penguin suit.
choices: I need to talk to you about penguins.

steps.text: Steal a cowbell from a dairy cow.
Speak to the sheep-penguins once again in the Lumbridge sheep farm to learn about the outpost.
Tell Larry about the outpost and travel back to the iceberg.
Jump in the penguin suit and talk to the KGP Agent on the north west portion of the iceberg.
Talk to Noodle.
Give Noodle the swamp tar to get an ID card and a mission report.
Talk to the KGP Agent again.
Enter the avalanche.
Enter the avalanche as a penguin.
Enter the avalanche as a penguin.
Talk to the KGP Agent in the first room to the west of the entrance.
Enter the door to the west of the KGP Agent to begin the agility course.
Complete the agility course.
Walk up to the start of the agility course.
Avoid the ice and exit the water.
Jump across the stepping stones.
Tread-softly across the icicles.
Cross ice to get up the hill.
Talk to the Agility Instructor.
Return to Larry to tell him about the penguin army. You can quickly return to him by removing the penguin suit.
Re-enter the outpost and talk to the KGP agent north of the entrance.
Talk to Ping or Pong in the room to the east.
Remove the penguin suit.
Use the mahogany plank on the leather to make bongos.
Return to Ping or Pong to give them the bongos and cowbells.
Return to Ping or Pong.
Open the control room doors via the control panel.
Enter the war room and walk a few steps in to be captured.
Kill icelords until you are able to leave through the door to the west. May take up to 3 kills.
Leave through the door to the west.
Use the chasm to exit the cave.
Return to Larry to finish the quest.
Perform the 3 emotes the penguins performed in the bird hide cutscene.
